facts.text: Kamehl Zadir, the club owner who finally waves the Butabi brothers past the rope
facts.why: The club owner is Benny Zadir. Kamehl is the brothers' father, Kamehl Butabi. Zadir doesn't wave them in either: Richard Grieco uses his fame to get them past the door, and the brothers meet Zadir inside.
facts.fix: Benny Zadir, the club owner who loves the brothers' idea for a club

facts.why: The brothers work in their father's artificial plant store. It sells fake plants, not flowers.

facts.text: Doug and Steve's round, on Richard Grieco's tab.
facts.why: Grieco gets the brothers into the club after the fender bender, but the pages read say nothing about him paying for drinks.
facts.fix: Doug and Steve's round, once Richard Grieco gets them in.

facts.text: Doug and Steve in matching suits
facts.why: The poster in the picture has Doug in a blue suit and Steve in magenta. None of the pages read say the suits match.
facts.fix: Doug and Steve in their shiny club suits

vibe.verdict: The velvet rope and head bob are right, but the wrong Zadir is printed and most of the film's best scenes are missing.
missing: Richard Grieco's Ferrari fender bender on the ATM run (the road to the club)
'Why go out for burgers when you have steak at home?' (Doug, outside the shop)
Credit Vixen, the card approval line Doug flirts with
Dooey stopping for fluffy whip on the way to Zadir's house
'You can take our phones and you can take our keys, but you cannot take away our dreams' (Doug)
'Guys, guys. This is the coat room. The club's in here.' (Richard Grieco)
ideas: Swap 'Neon pink raspberry cheesecake cups' for 'Dooey's fluffy whip raspberry cups', after the whipped cream stop.
Swap the plain note under 'Roxbury club sliders' for Doug's 'Why go out for burgers when you have steak at home?'
Swap 'Club cosmopolitan' for a 'Credit Vixen cosmo' on the bar list.
Swap the footer line 'No discussing the synchronized head bob at the tables' for 'This is the coat room. The club's in here.'
